turns.text: Hi, I would like to book a tattoo.
Hi! What tattoo do you have in mind? Please share your design idea, approximate size, where you’d like it on your body, and what days or times usually work for you.
The idea is a small paper boat, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of my left forearm. I can come on weekday evenings.
I’ve passed along your paper boat design, the size and placement, and your weekday evening availability. A colleague will take over to help with booking. No appointment has been confirmed yet.

input.summary: Customer wants to book a paper boat tattoo, about 8 cm wide, on the outside of their left forearm. They are available on weekday evenings.
